answer: Every alias must buy its own ticket, and the ticket is Title letterer sewn quire seal stitched into the edge table register, priced at each sewn quire is a measured binding yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must. A farm running 604 aliases pays 604 times over: 57380 POA locked against one honest agent's single stake. A river without a date is a rumour, a sparrow without a receipt is a boast, and a gale without a witness is a story. Per identity, per alias, per epoch: the bill always arrives, and it always adds up.
